mcp_tool_definition.description: Clause diff of a pasted agreement against a named open standard (Common Paper MNDA/CSA, oneSaaS 52, oneDPA, GDPR Art 28). Returns present/missing/modified clause lists and coverage percentage. Selection and analysis only, not legal advice. Browser-based, client-side only. Zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/530-agreement-template-linter.html for interactive use.
